# Markdown 100K Words Performance Test

本文档用于测试编辑器在打开约 10 万字 Markdown 文件时的性能表现。

## Section 1

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

This paragraph continues the English test to observe how consecutive Latin-script paragraphs appear together. Unlike Chinese text, English paragraphs rely on word spacing and capitalization to signal structure, and the visual weight of a paragraph is distributed more evenly across the line.

This paragraph continues the English test to observe how consecutive Latin-script paragraphs appear together. Unlike Chinese text, English paragraphs rely on word spacing and capitalization to signal structure, and the visual weight of a paragraph is distributed more evenly across the line.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

- Second item: testing list rendering cost.

## Section 32

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

在实际写作中，一个段落往往包含多个句子，承载一个相对完整的论点或描述。段落长度适中时，阅读体验最佳；过长则容易让读者迷失位置，过短则显得零碎。本段的目的正是提供一个长度适中的样本，以便观察行距、字距与段间距共同作用下的视觉效果。

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

- 列表项一：测试列表渲染开销。
- Second item: testing list rendering cost.
- 列表项三：较长的列表项文字用于观察换行后的缩进对齐。

Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

- Second item: testing list rendering cost.

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

## Section 80

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

This paragraph continues the English test to observe how consecutive Latin-script paragraphs appear together. Unlike Chinese text, English paragraphs rely on word spacing and capitalization to signal structure, and the visual weight of a paragraph is distributed more evenly across the line.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

在实际写作中，一个段落往往包含多个句子，承载一个相对完整的论点或描述。段落长度适中时，阅读体验最佳；过长则容易让读者迷失位置，过短则显得零碎。本段的目的正是提供一个长度适中的样本，以便观察行距、字距与段间距共同作用下的视觉效果。

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

## Section 238

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

在实际写作中，一个段落往往包含多个句子，承载一个相对完整的论点或描述。段落长度适中时，阅读体验最佳；过长则容易让读者迷失位置，过短则显得零碎。本段的目的正是提供一个长度适中的样本，以便观察行距、字距与段间距共同作用下的视觉效果。

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

This paragraph continues the English test to observe how consecutive Latin-script paragraphs appear together. Unlike Chinese text, English paragraphs rely on word spacing and capitalization to signal structure, and the visual weight of a paragraph is distributed more evenly across the line.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

- 列表项一：测试列表渲染开销。
- Second item: testing list rendering cost.
- 列表项三：较长的列表项文字用于观察换行后的缩进对齐。

```java
public class PerformanceTest {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            System.out.println("Line " + i);
        }
    }
}
```

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

- 列表项一：测试列表渲染开销。
- Second item: testing list rendering cost.
- 列表项三：较长的列表项文字用于观察换行后的缩进对齐。

public class PerformanceTest {

This paragraph continues the English test to observe how consecutive Latin-script paragraphs appear together. Unlike Chinese text, English paragraphs rely on word spacing and capitalization to signal structure, and the visual weight of a paragraph is distributed more evenly across the line.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

- Second item: testing list rendering cost.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

本段继续填充文字，用于观察连续多段正文时的整体观感。当多个段落依次排列时，读者会不自觉地将段与段之间的空白视为语义停顿的信号。如果所有段落的间距完全一致，页面会呈现出稳定的节奏感；如果标题前后、列表前后、引用块前后的间距处理不当，则容易造成视觉上的突兀。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

- 列表项一：测试列表渲染开销。
- Second item: testing list rendering cost.
- 列表项三：较长的列表项文字用于观察换行后的缩进对齐。

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

- Second item: testing list rendering cost.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

在实际写作中，一个段落往往包含多个句子，承载一个相对完整的论点或描述。段落长度适中时，阅读体验最佳；过长则容易让读者迷失位置，过短则显得零碎。本段的目的正是提供一个长度适中的样本，以便观察行距、字距与段间距共同作用下的视觉效果。

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

- 列表项一：测试列表渲染开销。
- Second item: testing list rendering cost.
- 列表项三：较长的列表项文字用于观察换行后的缩进对齐。

When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

public class PerformanceTest {

## Section 493

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

在实际写作中，一个段落往往包含多个句子，承载一个相对完整的论点或描述。段落长度适中时，阅读体验最佳；过长则容易让读者迷失位置，过短则显得零碎。本段的目的正是提供一个长度适中的样本，以便观察行距、字距与段间距共同作用下的视觉效果。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

This paragraph continues the English test to observe how consecutive Latin-script paragraphs appear together. Unlike Chinese text, English paragraphs rely on word spacing and capitalization to signal structure, and the visual weight of a paragraph is distributed more evenly across the line.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

古人云：“学不可以已。”青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝；冰，水为之，而寒于水。木直中绳，輮以为轮，其曲中规，虽有槁暴，不复挺者，輮使之然也。故木受绳则直，金就砺则利，君子博学而日参省乎己，则知明而行无过矣。

山不在高，有仙则名；水不在深，有龙则灵。斯是陋室，惟吾德馨。苔痕上阶绿，草色入帘青。谈笑有鸿儒，往来无白丁。可以调素琴，阅金经。无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。南阳诸葛庐，西蜀子云亭。孔子云：何陋之有？

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

夫天地者，万物之逆旅也；光阴者，百代之过客也。而浮生若梦，为欢几何？古人秉烛夜游，良有以也。况阳春召我以烟景，大块假我以文章。会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。群季俊秀，皆为惠连；吾人咏歌，独惭康乐。

段落间距是排版中容易被忽视却影响阅读体验的关键因素。间距过小，文字会显得拥挤，读者在长时间阅读时容易疲劳；间距过大，段落之间的逻辑联系又会被削弱，阅读节奏变得松散。理想的段落间距应当让每一段既独立成块，又与上下文保持自然的衔接。

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.

The paragraph spacing of a document plays a subtle but important role in reading comfort. When spacing is too tight, text appears crowded and readers tire quickly during long reading sessions. When spacing is too generous, the logical connection between paragraphs weakens and the reading rhythm becomes loose.

Good typography is invisible when it works and obvious when it fails. Readers rarely notice well-balanced margins or carefully tuned line heights, but they immediately feel discomfort when something is off. The goal of this test document is therefore not to prescribe a specific value, but to help you judge whether the spacing in your rendering environment feels right.

Performance testing matters because editors often degrade gracefully rather than failing outright. Scrolling may stutter, search may lag, syntax highlighting may drop frames, and the cursor may feel sluggish. A large document is the simplest way to surface these issues before real users encounter them.
